endpoint.selection: Exact explicit Config.EndpointOverrides (cloud_1c,v2,scope), selected after discovery; no guessed regional host; base includes /v2

request.body: CreateDatastoreRequest with required spec; required name/flavor, exact int64 node/flavor strings; absent type/nodeCount remain absent, no inserted defaults
request.reference: Created datastore is independent; no inferred cluster parent

response.mapping: Typed CreateDatastoreResponse; trustworthy ID scanned before unrelated decode failure; foreign projectId excluded; accepted receipt retained

errors.mapping: Core bounded read status mapping; provider message excluded; malformed JSON ProtocolError
errors.lost_response: unknown_outcome with one attempt; no inferred ID, no list/name adoption

retry: no mutation replay on any unknown response

wait.source_states: DatastoreStatus: ACTIVE succeeds, ERRORED/DELETED fail, documented transitions pending, missing/UNSPECIFIED/new values unknown
wait.absence: 404 is not readiness or deletion proof

recovery.kind: exact resource observation; unknown outcome remains indeterminate; no replay or authorship inference
